name: Hunter step 8b: tracking desert devils in the Uzer Hunter area. Inspect on the north burrow shows the first footprints of a trail of the player's own; a rockslide away from where they lead shows nothing; a patch of disturbed sand is empty while the trail goes on. The trail is random, so follow the rest by eye: Inspect the cacti and rockslides where the footprints stop until one shows more, then Attack the disturbed sand where they end with the noose wand wielded (::keys on)
